info.name: Order Payment API - Functional Testing
info.description:
Functional API testing collection for the Order Payment API project.

This collection covers core backend QA scenarios including customer creation, product creation, order placement, payment processing, order cancellation, negative validation, and database verification.

Testing focus:

- API status codes
    
- JSON response validation
    
- Business rule validation
    
- Order and payment status flow
    
- Database consistency checks
    
- Error handling for invalid inputs
